title: What If an Animal Floated in Open Space? Tardigrades Did

scenes.text: What if a living animal spent ten days in open space? Tiny tardigrades did.
In 2007 a European mission carried dried tardigrades into orbit, about 260 kilometers up, on the outside of a capsule.
Some were exposed to the vacuum of space. Others also got full, unfiltered sunlight.
After returning, more than 68 percent of the vacuum-only group revived within thirty minutes of rehydration.
Many of the survivors even produced viable embryos. Sunlight was harder: only three of one species lived.
Researchers still say how they revive remains a mystery.

description:
What if an animal floated in open space for ten days?
In 2007, tardigrades were flown into orbit, and many survived the vacuum and went on to produce embryos.
